reason: I verified all four pinned hashes and read both captures, the mapped source and diff fully. The sole substantive change is the documented email request for the existing private preview, while the retry cases remain intact. Both dispositions are supported. Q2's wording that error protection 'excludes failover' when Stripe was original could be read as suppressing a compatible alternate attempt, even though the companion guide suspends only fallback to Stripe in that case. The retry and mapped assessment need to give the distinct validation and event signals explicitly.
required_changes: Make the reciprocal failure handling in Q2 precise, and carry its exact API validation identity into the mapped assessment. Under opt-in error protection an unsupported feature may cause routing to Stripe. During cross-processor failover after an original Stripe attempt, Stripe ignores the error-protection configuration to avoid another Stripe attempt. This does not bar a compatible configured alternate solely because Stripe handled the first attempt. The routing guide specifically skips the alternate when it cannot handle the required feature. Give the separate HTTP 400 orchestration_unsupported request validation, which reports the first unsupported feature, and distinguish it from the payment_intent.payment_failed webhook on the documented initial 3DS branch. Keep the optional Adaptive Acceptance attempts and normal cross-processor retry separate. Cite the related May feature-support lines 12-16, November feature-support lines 25-29 and November routing lines 222-226 rather than treating these as a November change in the retry guide.

source_assessment_decisions.reason: The required update accurately restores the draft, 3DS, Stripe-main and preview scopes and links error protection reciprocally. Complete the companion warning with the exact unsupported-feature validation code and distinguish disabling fallback to Stripe from eligibility of the configured alternate.
